note: Chaos Turbo / Chaos Control — docs/goat-decks.md §2.3. Names validated against cards.cdb.

[GW] GoatWorld, "Goat Format Staples" and "Goat Control Deck Guide": https://goatworld.community/blog/goat-format-staples-must-have-cards-explained and https://goatworld.community/blog/goat-control-complete-deck-guide (Dark Balter off Airknight Parshath; activate Scapegoat in the opponent's End Phase)
manual:
**Game plan:** Goat Control with the dial toward tempo; leverage DARK/LIGHT density to spam Chaos.

**Key cards / engine:** Mystic Tomato recruiter chain; Chaos Sorcerer x2 + BLS; Zaborg.

**How to pilot / combo lines:**
- **`Mystic Tomato` fuels everything:** it dies to Special Summon a DARK (≤1500 ATK) from deck [CDB] — fetch `Sinister Serpent`, `Don Zaloog`, or another Tomato — chaining bodies while stocking DARKs in the grave for Chaos.
- **Keep a live LIGHT count** (Airknight, D.D. Warrior Lady, Magician of Faith) so `Chaos Sorcerer`/`BLS` (each needs "1 LIGHT and 1 DARK" banished [CDB]) are always online: banish their best monster, then swing.
- **`Zaborg the Thunder Monarch`** tributes a token or spent Tomato on summon to pop a monster — tempo plus a body.
- You are the beatdown in control mirrors and still hold the full trap suite vs aggro. Same Scapegoat→Metamorphosis→TER two-turn line as Goat Control for the reset.

**Weaknesses:** graveyard hate (`Kycoo`, `Soul Release`, `D.D. Warrior Lady`) shuts your Chaos off; drawing Chaos monsters with no LIGHT/DARK in grave = dead cards early.

=== EXTRA DECK ===

**One door: `Metamorphosis` — "Tribute 1 monster. Special Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck with the same Level as the Tributed monster" [CDB].** No `Polymerization`, no `Cyber-Stein`; `Magical Scientist` is **Forbidden** in GOAT [GF-BAN]. Tokens are legal material ("including a Sheep Token from `Scapegoat`"), Metamorphosis "cannot be activated" if no Fusion in the list matches the tributed monster's Level, and it "does not properly Summon a Fusion Monster, so you cannot use `Monster Reborn` on it afterwards" [GR].

**This is the best-fed Extra Deck of the GOAT builds here — every Level in it is live. Lv1:** Sheep Token, `Sinister Serpent`, `Magician of Faith`. **Lv5:** `Airknight Parshath`, `Zaborg the Thunder Monarch`. **Lv6:** `Chaos Sorcerer` ×2.

- **`Ryu Senshi` (Lv6) off `Chaos Sorcerer` — the deck's real kill-turn button**, "the most commonly used level 6 fusion monster, and it [is] mostly used for setting up kill turns via Chaos Sorcerer+Metamorphosis" [GF-FUS] — and you run *two* Sorcerers, so you can do it twice. Sorcerer "cannot attack the turn you activate this effect" [CDB]: banish their blocker, then convert the idle Sorcerer into a 2000 attacker where it pays 1000 LP to negate a **Normal Trap** (`Mirror Force`, `Torrential Tribute`, `Sakuretsu Armor`, `Ring of Destruction` — *not* the Counter Trap `Solemn Judgment`) and "negate[s] the effects of any Spell Card that targets this card and destroy[s] it" [CDB], walking through `Book of Moon` and `Snatch Steal`.
- **`Dark Balter the Terrible` (Lv5) — off `Zaborg` first, `Airknight` second:** "after Thousand-Eyes Restrict, this is the most commonly used fusion monster brought forth with Metamorphosis … the potential to negate both spells and monster effects is quite powerful" [GF-FUS]; it is usually made off `Airknight Parshath` [GW], but here `Zaborg the Thunder Monarch` is the better fodder — its pop only triggers "if this card is Tribute Summoned" [CDB], so a Zaborg that has already popped is a spent 2400 body. Trade it for a 2000 where it pays 1000 LP to negate a Normal Spell (`Pot of Greed`, `Graceful Charity`, `Heavy Storm`, `Nobleman of Crossout`) and negates the effect of any Effect Monster it kills in battle [CDB].
- **`Thousand-Eyes Restrict` (Lv1)** — "the most frequent and most powerful fusion monster special summoned with Metamorphosis … it can take the opponent's best monster while locking down the field at the same time" [GF-FUS]. Goats in their End Phase [GW], token → Metamorphosis on your turn, then **absorb with priority** — in GOAT rules "when a Chain or Summon has finished resolving, the turn player can activate a fast effect *or a monster's Ignition Effect* before the opponent is allowed to respond" [GF-BASICS], so equip the instant Metamorphosis resolves, before `Book of Moon` can land; if they flip it down first, TER "needs to be face up on the field to attach a monster to itself, so its effect will fizzle" [GR]. ⚠ TER freezes your Tomatoes and Chaos beaters too — in a tempo deck it is the brake, not the accelerator. Pull it when you are behind on board; `Tsukuyomi` takes it off *and* re-arms the absorb [GF-GOAT]. Also, monsters equipped to TER "do not have effects and are treated as Equip Spell Cards" [GR], so it blanks what it steals.
- **`Musician King` (Lv5) — LIGHT fuel, and only off a *stolen* Level 5.** The sourced line is precise: "in the rare situations where you have `Snatch Steal` for your opponent's `Airknight Parshath` and need to Metamorphosis for a light monster in your graveyard for a chaos monster [it] could be the difference between winning and losing the game" [GF-FUS]. The mechanism is the point — the monster you took with `Snatch Steal` returns to *their* Graveyard when you tribute it, so the LIGHT you bank is the Fusion itself once it dies. That matters more in this deck than in any other here: two `Chaos Sorcerer` plus `BLS` each need "1 LIGHT and 1 DARK" banished [CDB] while `Mystic Tomato` only ever stocks DARK. Converting your *own* `Airknight`/`Zaborg` does nothing for this — they are already LIGHT in your Graveyard. That guide picks `Giltia the D. Knight` (also LIGHT, Level 5, 1850 ATK) for this slot and never names Musician King — same job, 100 more ATK.
